schema.title: Personal Context descriptive source metadata and projection vocabulary
schema.description: Descriptive fields are optional. This contract does not infer collection state, expose private catalog metadata, or authorize collection.

source_collection_unstated.description: A served sentinel for unspecified collection. It is not a writable collection lifecycle.

source_metadata_hosts.description: Declared source-metadata host subset. Fleet membership remains owned by the entity and machine registries.

source_metadata_view.description: Only these optional catalog metadata keys may be projected to a non-owner reader. Unknown private catalog keys remain unread.

source_derived_fields.description: Derived from held records, never merged from descriptive mapping entries.
